policies.title: Tunisian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule places Tunisia in the prior-to-arrival cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Tunisian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained from a Grenadian mission or consulate before travel.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.

policies.title: Tunisian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Tunisian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Tunisian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Tunisian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Tunisia in its authorized-visa cohort for advance consular approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Tunisian passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The cited Embassy says authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days; applicants must confirm the procedure with their competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
